answer: Synchronous proof-of-personhood makes each extra identity pay one human's undivided 2 minutes; a farm running N fakes hires N humans for the same window and cannot share one person because all 6 FLIP puzzles decrypt at the same second. At 13:30 UTC, from a tundra outpost to a city flat, each identity solves its picture puzzles in 2 minutes; clones that mirror each other's answers are flagged as one echo. A 1,000-fake farm dies by simultaneous-ceremony check at 1,000: one missed window kills the identity, and the check repeats every 21 days.
